The batch did not crash randomly. It processed **SCJ-338 through SCJ-357**, then stuck on **SCJ-358** and retried that same case 30 times.

**Cause.** SCJ-358 is a one-page Clause 6.5 billing relegation (`Sahdeo Singh v. State of Uttar Pradesh`, Writ-C 10546 of 2025). The stencil classified it correctly, then fill failed with `stencil fill incomplete` because the caption parser only knew Lucknow’s dotted form (`.....Petitioner`). This Allahabad extract uses `Petitioner :- Sahdeo Singh`, so title came out empty.

**Fix.** The stencil now reads Allahabad `Petitioner :-` / `Respondent :-` captions, `Order Date :- 10.4.2025`, and “within two weeks”. If a title still cannot be parsed, the ticket falls back to short/full instead of a broken stencil. The loop stops after **3** consecutive stencil write failures instead of burning the rest of the batch.

**SCJ-358 is done** (`next_seq=359`): writ disposed; petitioner relegated to Clause 6.5.
